summary: Form still too box-like: greenhouse is too tall, pillars too thin and hood lacks the downward front slope of the concept.
notes: Deterministic geometry checks passed, then actual comparison inspected. Circular lamps and eight spokes present, but cabin proportion is not accepted; lower the window opening by raising the belt locally, slope the bonnet down towards existing front height, thicken paint margins.

features.notes: Wheelbase fits but large greenhouse changes the design.
Closed wells and fitted arches retained.
Too much glass height and insufficient painted margins.
Two round lamps present; lower openings and fascia still need shaping.
